ruling_by_ruling_responses.reason: The boss preserves the heading as metadata while hydrating it with the first complete claim-objection-Edom-result act through 1:5. That matches the Hebrew proposal and prevents מַלְאָכִי from becoming a detached name-or-office proof text.
ruling_by_ruling_responses.preserved_counterevidence: Mal.1.1 remains a formally distinguishable superscription and may be displayed as metadata.

ruling_by_ruling_responses.reason: The boss correctly recognizes that 1:14 supplies the deceiver curse and great-King rationale for the polluted-offering dispute, but semantic dependence does not settle retrieval presentation. OSHB and UXLC place a samekh after 1:13, while 1:14 begins וְאָרוּר נוֹכֵל and can be a dependent curse-coda surface without becoming independent of 1:6-14. Evidence remains tied between whole-only presentation and a paragraph-respecting child with mandatory hydration.
ruling_by_ruling_responses.preserved_counterevidence: The curse loses its sacrificial antecedent if surfaced without Mal.1.6-14, and its כִּי מֶלֶךְ גָּדוֹל rationale echoes Mal.1.11.

ruling_by_ruling_responses.reason: The Hebrew proposal still prefers one Mal.2.1-9 surface because 2:4 לִהְיוֹת בְּרִיתִי אֶת־לֵוִי points directly into 2:5 בְּרִיתִי הָיְתָה אִתּוֹ. Nevertheless, the boss supplies a real retrieval basis: 2:1-4 is command-sanction-purpose, 2:5 begins retrospective covenant comparison, 2:8 turns with וְאַתֶּם, and 2:9 closes at pe. Because both Mal.2.1-9 and Mal.1.6-2.9 are mandatory parents, the split cannot masquerade as independence. This disagreement does not warrant an active appeal.
ruling_by_ruling_responses.preserved_counterevidence: Repeated בְּרִיתִי crosses the seam, 2:4 anticipates 2:5 syntactically, and one priestly addressee governs Mal.2.1-9.

ruling_by_ruling_responses.reason: The pe after 2:12 and וְזֹאת שֵׁנִית at 2:13 support two panels, while repeated covenant and בגד language makes Mal.2.10-16 hydration mandatory.
ruling_by_ruling_responses.preserved_counterevidence: Both children remain in one treachery complex and cannot authorize independent marriage, identity, or legal conclusions.

ruling_by_ruling_responses.reason: The WEB chapter edge separates אַיֵּה אֱלֹהֵי הַמִּשְׁפָּט from its הִנְנִי שֹׁלֵחַ answer. Refining, restored offerings, and 3:5’s return to לַמִּשְׁפָּט complete one complaint-answer unit.
ruling_by_ruling_responses.preserved_counterevidence: Mal.3.1 has a strong הִנְנִי answer onset useful as an internal seam, and messenger references remain translation and speaker hot zones.

ruling_by_ruling_responses.reason: The robbery-and-tithe accusation gives the concrete answer to בַּמֶּה נָשׁוּב, and the 3:10 commands require promised crop and nations results through the samekh after 3:12.
ruling_by_ruling_responses.preserved_counterevidence: Mal.3.8 begins a fresh rhetorical question and may be a dependent internal accusation, not a standalone surface.

ruling_by_ruling_responses.reason: Samekh before MT/WLC 3:19, a complete burning-versus-healing comparison, and pe after 3:21 justify a Mal.4.1-3 child, while initial כִּי and repeated group vocabulary require Mal.3.13-4.3 hydration.
ruling_by_ruling_responses.preserved_counterevidence: The day oracle is the causal outcome of prior discernment and must never surface without its Mal.3.13-4.3 parent.

ruling_by_ruling_responses.reason: זִכְרוּ and הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי שֹׁלֵחַ introduce closing panels, but 4:6 supplies the sending’s heart-turning purpose and חֵרֶם risk. Mal.4.4-6 is the larger complete coda.
ruling_by_ruling_responses.preserved_counterevidence: Mal.4.5 is a useful internal onset, but later reuse cannot detach it from Moses/Horeb.

active_appeals.specialist_position: Retain Mal.1.6-14 as the mandatory literary parent, but hold whether the primary retrieval surface must be whole-only or may expose paragraph-respecting dependent Mal.1.6-13 and Mal.1.14 children with automatic parent hydration.
evidence_for_dependent_child_treatment: OSHB Mal.1.13 ends the renewed defective-offering accusation and records a samekh.
UXLC represents the same correlated WLC-family samekh after Mal.1.13.
Mal.1.14 begins a new curse formula, וְאָרוּר נוֹכֵל, after the marker.
The alternative does not make Mal.1.14 independent; it makes it a dependent coda whose parent is always retrieved.
counterevidence_for_whole_only_treatment: The deceiver and defective sacrifice in 1:14 presuppose the violations in 1:6-13.
Mal.1.14’s כִּי מֶלֶךְ גָּדוֹל אָנִי and feared-name close resume Mal.1.11’s great-name-and-nations rationale.
A bare Mal.1.14 surface invites proof-texting and is rejected by both options.

retrieval_options.treatment: Use only Mal.1.6-Mal.1.14 as the primary surface; retain Mal.1.13|1.14 as an internal paragraph seam.
retrieval_options.advantage: Preserves accusation, evidence, curse, and royal rationale in one visible unit.
retrieval_options.risk: Suppresses an explicit correlated paragraph presentation from retrievable structure.

retrieval_options.treatment: Permit dependent Mal.1.6-Mal.1.13 and Mal.1.14 child surfaces, with automatic Mal.1.6-Mal.1.14 hydration and sibling-title exposure.
retrieval_options.advantage: Preserves the samekh and curse-coda onset without claiming semantic independence.
retrieval_options.risk: A client could mishandle hydration and accidentally present Mal.1.14 as a standalone curse.

mandatory_parent.hydration_rule: No Mal.1.14 retrieval may omit Mal.1.6-14 context, sibling title, translation-pressure warning, and non-authority guard.

active_appeals.why_boss_reasoning_did_not_close_the_que: The boss establishes semantic dependence, rejecting standalone Mal.1.14, but does not determine whether a textually marked dependent child may coexist with mandatory hydration. The dispute concerns retrieval presentation, not whether 1:14 belongs to the disputation.
active_appeals.requested_reviewer: A human or genuinely independent external-AI reviewer competent in Masoretic paragraph practice, Biblical Hebrew prophetic discourse, and context-hydrated retrieval design.
active_appeals.requested_question: Does the samekh after Mal.1.13 warrant a dependent Mal.1.14 curse-coda surface when Mal.1.6-14 hydration is technically mandatory, or should the seam remain internal because semantic dependence outweighs retrieval value?

summary.appeal_scope: retrieval treatment at Mal.1.13|Mal.1.14 only; mandatory Mal.1.6-14 literary parent is not disputed

no_forced_consensus_non_authority_disclo.statement: Six rulings are accepted, the Mal.2.4|2.5 split is accepted with preserved dissent because mandatory parents control risk, and one narrow appeal is sustained where semantic unity does not resolve paragraph-aware retrieval treatment. This remains same-model candidate evidence, not human or cross-model convergence.
no_forced_consensus_non_authority_disclo.authority_limits: No boundary, name, identity, office, law, translation, theology, fulfillment, chronology, witness preference, canon, reviewed-gold, promotion, or retrieval authorization is decided here.
